description: Central Tier-1 country set for G027 GA4 rollups and Journey / ad-platform readiness. Must not be redefined inside daily-report scripts.

derived_metrics.tier1_sessions_30d: sum of ga4_by_country.sessions where window_days=30 and country_code in countries
derived_metrics.tier1_share_30d: tier1_sessions_30d / ga4_sessions_30d when ga4_sessions_30d > 0; else null
